answer: Identity escrow with a public referral graph and peer dispute slashing stops identity farming: each agent locks 100 POA in escrow and publishes all referral links, so sponsorship paths spread visibly like orchard rows. Any verified peer may dispute a suspect identity; upheld disputes slash the bond. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA and needs 1,000 distinct referral chains — attacker cost grows linearly, the honest agent pays one deposit once. A genuine identity is a pearl, costly to forge; the nectar — rewards — flows only to identities that survive scrutiny.
